Have a research question, a dataset to analyse or a programme to evaluate? Tell me what you want to find out and by when. The quickest way to reach me is WhatsApp or LinkedIn.

[WhatsApp me](https://wa.me/254111991749?text=Hello%20Aran%2C%20I%20would%20like%20to%20discuss%20a%20data%20or%20research%20project.){.btn .btn-primary}
[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aranfelix/){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
[GitHub](https://github.com/aranfelix){.btn .btn-outline-dark}

## What to include in your message

- What you want to find out or decide
- What data you already have, or whether it still needs to be collected
- Your deadline
- Whether the result is for a report, a donor, a publication or a dashboard

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
if (file.exists("formspree-id.txt")) {
  id <- trimws(readLines("formspree-id.txt", warn = FALSE)[1])
  cat('\n## Or send a message here\n\n')
  cat(sprintf('<form class="contact-form" action="https://formspree.io/f/%s" method="POST">
<div class="contact-field"><label for="name">Name</label><input id="name" type="text" name="name" required></div>
<div class="contact-field"><label for="email">Your email</label><input id="email" type="email" name="email" required></div>
<div class="contact-field"><label for="message">Message</label><textarea id="message" name="message" rows="6" required></textarea></div>
<div class="hidden-field" aria-hidden="true"><input type="text" name="_gotcha" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></div>
<button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Send message</button>
</form>
<p>Your details are used only to reply to your message.</p>\n', id))
}
```
